results.title: The Cast of Superstore: What Are They Doing Now?
results.description: While it might not have swept up an endless mantle of Emmy awards during its six-season run, Superstore did something much rarer: it captured the hearts of millions. The comedy series was the perfect blend of hilarious, soulful, and surprisingly dramatic – and if you ask any retail worker, it was almost terrifyingly true to life. Cloud 9 didn’t just hit us with unforgettable gags; it gave us real, grounded characters whose high stakes made us lean right in. That emotional depth proved to be the ultimate launching pad for its ensemble, allowing several cast members to branch out into
